name: Safavid Painter
findings: Within his own canvases, dark goldenrod turns up as a small accent in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 1.7x the archive's rate (from 1096 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, old gold turns up as the lightest note in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 2.9x the archive's rate (from 1096 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, hay's russet turns up as the shadow in 80% of the paintings that hold it, 3.6x the archive's rate (from 1096 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1096 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1096 paintings here).
Pairs blue with helvetia blue more than chance would predict (3 of 1096 paintings here).
Pairs deep bluish grey-green with delft blue more than chance would predict (3 of 1096 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (putty, tan, stone) covers 56% of his paintings here.
